errors.description: probe_bits_q is a multi-bit value produced in snoop_clk and sampled directly in cache_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
probe_pulse_q is a one-cycle snoop_clk pulse consumed directly in cache_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
probe_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample cache_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in cache_event_o.
probe_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector probe_mode_q before decoding in cache_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
snoop_rst_n is used as data inside cache_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
core_snapshot_q combines snoop_clk payload state with cache_clk status state in core_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
